# What Hi-Fi?

> What Hi-Fi? is the definitive resource for hi-fi audio, home cinema, headphones, and consumer electronics reviews, news, and buying advice.

What Hi-Fi? provides comprehensive coverage of audio equipment, televisions, streaming services, and portable devices from leading brands including Sony, Bowers & Wilkins, KEF, Naim, and Apple. The site combines expert product reviews, industry news, curated buying guides, and annual awards to help consumers make informed purchasing decisions.

## Key Topics

- Hi-Fi Audio
- Headphones
- Speakers
- Home Cinema
- Soundbars
- OLED Televisions
- Turntables
- DAC (Digital-to-Analog Converter)
- Dolby Atmos
- Music Streaming
- Product Reviews
- Buying Advice
- Audio Equipment
- Surround Sound
- Wireless Speakers

## Core Product Categories

- [Hi-Fi Coverage](https://www.whathifi.com/hi-fi): Hi-fi category hub covering amplifiers, turntables, DACs, and music streamers
- [Headphones](https://www.whathifi.com/headphones): Headphones hub with Sony WH-1000XM5 and Bowers Wilkins Px7 S3 coverage
- [Speakers](https://www.whathifi.com/speakers): Speakers hub featuring KEF, Acoustic Energy, and wireless speaker reviews
- [TV & Home Cinema](https://www.whathifi.com/tv-home-cinema): TV and home cinema hub covering soundbars, receivers, and OLED televisions
- [AV Coverage](https://www.whathifi.com/av): AV hub covering home cinema, speakers, and audio-visual product reviews

## Reviews & Recommendations

- [Latest Reviews](https://www.whathifi.com/reviews): Product reviews for headphones, speakers, and home cinema equipment
- [Best Buys](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys): Curated best buy recommendations for audio and home cinema products
- [What Hi-Fi? Awards 2025](https://www.whathifi.com/awards): Annual awards recognizing best hi-fi, home cinema, and portable products
- [Buying Advice](https://www.whathifi.com/advice): Product comparison and buying advice for headphones, speakers, and TVs

## News & Features

- [Latest News](https://www.whathifi.com/news): Latest hi-fi and home cinema news including Bowers and Wilkins, Quad products
- [In-Depth Features](https://www.whathifi.com/features): In-depth feature articles on hi-fi audio, speakers, and streaming technology
- [Best Deals](https://www.whathifi.com/deals): Current deals and discounts on headphones, turntables, and audio equipment

## Streaming & Entertainment

- [Streaming & Entertainment](https://www.whathifi.com/streaming-entertainment): Streaming services and entertainment coverage including Spotify and Sky TV
